status: Pre-fix CTUI-26 scale evidence; CTUI-53 cancellation cleanup barrier remains mandatory. This is not an all-gates-pass report.

commands.aotCompile: nice -n 19 dart compile exe benchmark/records.dart -o build/records
commands.smallControl: add --small to the matching runtime command

commandScope: Commands normalize the owned executable output to build/records; source and package locks came from the exact base archive plus the two benchmark/reference files. All runs were sequential in reserved heavy slots.

instrumentation.limits: Named snapshots add external lsof calls between stages; original counts-only and diagnostic versions are retained separately. No mixed-instrumentation or cross-runtime speed ratio. Leading slashes in descriptor paths are relative to the owned root, not system paths.

workloadNotes: Each default run freshly wrote 2000 records (139890199 bytes), including 64KiB irrelevant payload per file and one additional 8MiB line; OS caches were warm after creation. Selected history was 4000 turns/12000 actions/8000 entries (1401340 bytes). Steady frames are 50 unpaced back-to-back draws and cell diffs. The stalled append is an injected gate, not filesystem flush or durability timing.

retainedHandleObservations.jit2: Initial retained end-handle observation; descriptor name was not captured. The series stopped for the bounded diagnostic, preserving this raw JSON.
retainedHandleObservations.diagnostic: One DIR /records immediately after cancel; later snapshots zero. It does not identify the earlier retained end handle.
retainedHandleObservations.namedRecurrences: JIT3 and AOT1 retain REG record-file descriptors from afterCancelScan through root deletion. All names and descriptor numbers are retained in their JSONs.
retainedHandleObservations.disposition: The historical acceptance of unresolved handles was superseded by CTUI-53; no final cancellation cleanup pass is claimed.

metricLimits: Physical isolate count and exit latency are unmeasured. Cancellation latency is request to Future settlement only. OS descriptor counts are direct lsof observations; operation futures and instrumented scanner streams are separate counters. No samples means null, not zero measured latency. RSS peak is cumulative for each process. Bun is a separately labelled original reference with different runtime/features and no synthetic Actions input.
responsivenessDisposition: Transcript first-layout/resize hitches and the separate 2000-choice picker navigation redraw hitch are retained. Main deferred the picker all-item redraw concern to a framework follow-up; no framework/cache change or O(visible rows) claim is made here.
cleanupScope: Every actual fixture root was deleted; each process exited, scratch binaries and outer TMPDIR/XDG were removed, and no owned process remained. This does not imply zero descriptors before process exit; the pre-fix failure counts above remain failures for CTUI-53.
